title: Freeze Capsule
summary: Save Linux freeze clues before a reboot erases them.
user: Desktop Linux users who need evidence after a freeze, before rebooting loses graphics, kernel, app, and session clues.
smallest_useful_product: A least-privilege watchdog that keeps an encrypted, bounded snapshot current, promotes it after a watchdog gap or hotkey, and renders a redacted report.
constraints: Disclose that a hard lock can stop capture.
Do not modify the kernel or file bug reports.
